en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Getting horny after a meal
Taking a nap after a meal
Exercising after a meal

Hmm... Are you a person with 
a strong sense of lust?
There is nothing wrong with lust.

But there is one thing 
you should never forget.

True love is not a physical connection, 
but a mental connection...

I would appreciate if you kept that in
the back of your mind at all times.

Obeying desires is one way to live...
but you may miss things when asleep.

If you wish to pursue the path of an
anthropologist, you must stay vigilant.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm not trying to become an
anthropologist or anything...

I do not agree with 
that philosophy...

Exercising after a meal is a practice 
of modern times to maintain physique.

I would prefer you spend time giving 
thanks for the lives you have eaten.

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Korekiyo's inner thoughts...?
